lean.statement:
∀
  {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] {f : E → ℝ}
  {β h : ℝ},
  0 ≤ h →
    β * h ≤ 1 →
      (∀ (x y : E), f y ≤ f x + inner ℝ (gradient f x) (y - x) + β / 2 * ‖y - x‖ ^ 2) →
        ∀ (x : E), f (x - h • gradient f x) - f x ≤ -(h / 2) * ‖gradient f x‖ ^ 2
approved_definition_context: gradient f x is the Riesz vector of the totalized Frechet derivative; no differentiability is imposed by the notation alone.
IsMinOn f Set.univ z means f(z)<=f(x) for every x in the entire domain.
Function.iterate T N, written T^[N], is N-fold composition; T^[0] is the identity.
